section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The vehicle routing problem, last mile delivery, or waste collection analysis layer to which routes will be added.
The number of routes that will be added.

A qualifier that will be added to the name of every route. For example, a route name prefix of WeekdayRoute would be used as the starting text for every route's name with an incrementing numerical suffix appended to it (for example, WeekdayRoute1, WeekdayRoute2, and so on).

The name of the starting depot for the route. If this value is null, the route will begin from the first order assigned. Omitting the start depot is useful when the vehicle's starting location is unknown or irrelevant to the problem. For vehicle routing problem layers, when this value is null, the End Depot Name parameter value cannot also be null. Both start and end depots can be null for last mile delivery and waste collection layers. Virtual start depots are not allowed if orders or depots are in multiple time zones.

The name of the ending depot for the route. If this value is null, the route will end at the last order assigned. For vehicle routing problem layers, when this value is null, the Start Depot Name parameter value cannot also be null. Both start and end depots can be null for last mile delivery and waste collection layers.

The earliest allowable start time for the route in a vehicle routing problem layer. This parameter is used by the solver in conjunction with the time window of the starting depot provided in the Depots sublayer by the TimeWindowStart field for determining feasible route start times. This parameter has a default time-only value of 8:00:00 a.m., which is interpreted as 8:00:00 a.m. on the date provided by the Default Date property of the analysis layer. If no value is specified, the default value is used. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a vehicle routing problem layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type.

The latest allowable start time for the route in a vehicle routing problem layer. This parameter has a default time-only value of 10:00:00 a.m., which is interpreted as 10:00:00 a.m. on the date provided by the Default Date property of the analysis layer. If no value is specified, the default value is used. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a vehicle routing problem layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type.

The maximum allowable number of orders on the route. The default value is 30 for vehicle routing problem layers and null for last mile delivery layers. If no value is specified, the default value is used. This parameter is not applicable and is hidden if the input layer is a waste collection layer.

The maximum amount (volume, weight, quantity, and so on) that can be carried by the vehicle. A null value is the same as zero. A maximum of nine capacity fields are allowed, but use only the number necessary to model the needs of the vehicles. This parameter is not applicable and is hidden if the input layer is a waste collection layer. Value table columns: Capacity_1—The first capacity field. Capacity_2—The second capacity field. Capacity_3—The third capacity field. Capacity_4—The fourth capacity field. Capacity_5—The fifth capacity field. Capacity_6—The sixth capacity field. Capacity_7—The seventh capacity field. Capacity_8—The eight capacity field. Capacity_9—The nine capacity field.

The constraints that will be placed on routes to limit total time, total travel time, and total distance. This parameter is not applicable and is hidden if the input layer is a waste collection layer. Value table columns: Max Total Time—The maximum allowable route duration. The route duration includes travel times as well as service and wait times at orders, depots, and breaks. Specify the value in the input layer's time units. Max Total Travel Time—The maximum allowable travel time for the route. The travel time includes only the time spent driving on the network and does not include service or wait times. This field value can't be larger than the MaxTotalTime field value. Specify the value in the input layer's time units. Max Total Distance—The maximum allowable travel distance for the route. Specify the value in the input layer's distance units.

The costs that may be incurred by the route in a solution. This parameter is not applicable and is hidden if the input layer is a waste collection layer. Value table columns: Fixed Cost—A fixed monetary cost that is incurred only if the route is used in a solution (that is, it has orders assigned to it). Cost Per Unit Time—The monetary cost incurred per unit of work time for the total route duration, including travel times and service and wait times at orders, depots, and breaks. Cost Per Unit Distance—The monetary cost incurred per unit of distance traveled for the route length (total travel distance). Overtime Start Time—The duration of regular work time before overtime computation begins. Cost Per Unit Overtime—The monetary cost incurred per time unit of overtime work. This field can contain null values; a null value indicates that the Cost Per Unit Overtime value is the same as the Cost Per Unit Time value.

Additional route time options. This parameter is not applicable and is hidden if the input layer is a waste collection layer. Value table columns: Start Depot Service Time—The service time at the starting depot. This can be used to model the time spent loading the vehicle. End Depot Service Time—The service time at the ending depot. This can be used to model the time spent unloading the vehicle. Arrive/Depart Delay—The amount of travel time needed to accelerate the vehicle to normal travel speeds, decelerate it to a stop, and move it off and on the network (for example, in and out of parking). By including an Arrive/Depart Delay value, the solver is deterred from sending many routes to service physically coincident orders.

Specifies whether new routes will be appended to the existing routes attribute table. Checked—New routes will be appended to the existing set in the routes attribute table. This is the default. Unchecked—Existing routes will be deleted and replaced with new routes.

Additional date and time properties for a last mile delivery layer. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a last mile delivery layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type. Value table columns: Earliest Route Start Date—The earliest start date for added routes. If this property is not specified, the routes will use the layer's default earliest route start date. Earliest Route Start Time—The earliest start time of day for added routes. If this property is not specified, the routes will use the layer's default earliest route start time. Route Start Flexibility—Indicates how long after the earliest allowed route start time the route can start. The value can be zero, which means that there is no flexibility in the starting time, or a positive number. Specify the value in the input layer's time units.

The capacities for routes in a waste collection layer. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a waste collection layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type. Value table columns: MaxBins_1—The maximum number of waste bins for fraction 1 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. MaxWeight_1—The maximum physical weight for fraction 1 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. Any weight units can be used for this value as long as the same units are used for all weight fields. MaxVolume_1—The maximum volume for fraction 1 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. Any volume units can be used for this value as long as the same units are used for all volume fields. MaxBins_2—The maximum number of waste bins for fraction 2 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. MaxWeight_2—The maximum physical weight for fraction 2 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. Any weight units can be used for this value as long as the same units are used for all weight fields. MaxVolume_2—The maximum volume for fraction 2 that the vehicle can collect before it must be emptied. Any volume units can be used for this value as long as the same units are used for all volume fields.

Additional date and time properties for a waste collection layer. Although you can specify both a date and a time for the Start Time property, only the time portion is used. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a waste collection layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type. Value table columns: Start Time—The starting time for the route. If this property is not specified, the routes will use the layer's default start time. Overtime Start Time—The duration of regular work time before overtime computation begins. A null value indicates that overtime does not apply. Specify the value in the input layer's time units.

The constraints that will be placed on routes to limit total time and distance. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a waste collection layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type. Value table columns: Max Total Time—The maximum allowable route duration. The route duration includes travel times as well as service and wait times at stops, depots, and renewals. Specify the value in the input layer's time units. Max Total Distance—The maximum allowable travel distance for the route. Specify the value in the input layer's distance units.

Additional route time properties. This parameter is only applicable if the input layer is a waste collection layer. It is hidden if the input layer has a different solver type. Value table columns: Start Depot Service Time—The service time at the starting depot. This can be used to model the time spent loading the vehicle. End Depot Service Time—The service time at the ending depot. This can be used to model the time spent unloading the vehicle.

topic: 概化 (編輯工具)
text:
此工具會修改輸入資料。 有關詳細信息以及避免意外更改資料的策略，請參閱修改或更新輸入資料的工具。
此工具使用與簡化線工具的點移除方法（道格拉斯-普克簡化算法）相同的算法。 簡化線工具提供了更多的參數，并會創建一個新的輸出，而此工具則直接修改輸入圖徵類。
此工具可按記錄逐一概化圖徵。 運行此工具后，圖徵之間之前重合的線段和面邊界可能不再重合。
貝塞爾曲線段、圓弧段和橢圓弧段將轉換為一組直線段。
此工具不會刪除記錄或圖徵。 如果容差比某個面大，則該面將縮減為三個折點。

topic: 概化 (編輯工具)
text:
Generalize 示例 2（獨立腳本）
以下獨立腳本示例演示了如何在先對圖徵進行簡化然后再進行緩衝的工作流中使用 Generalize 函數：

topic: 概化 (編輯工具)
text:
# Name: BufferZones.py
# Purpose: Simplify features using the Generalize tool and then Buffer them

# Import script modules
import arcpy

# Set the workspace
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/data/data.gdb"

# Set local parameters
inFeatures = "zones"
gTolerance = "4 Feet"
copFeatures = "zones_cp"
bufDist = "50 Miles"
bufOutput = "zones_buff"

# Since Generalize permanently updates the input, first make a copy of the
# original feature class
arcpy.management.CopyFeatures(inFeatures, copFeatures)

# Use the Generalize tool to simplify the Buffer input to shorten Buffer
# processing time
arcpy.edit.Generalize(copFeatures, gTolerance)

# Buffer the output
arcpy.analysis.Buffer(copFeatures, bufOutput, bufDist)

topic: TanH (影像分析工具)
text: 計算網格中像元的雙曲正切值。

topic: TanH (影像分析工具)
text:
在數學中，所有三角函數都具有一個確定的有效輸入值范圍，該范圍稱為域。 每個函數中的輸出值也具有一個確定的范圍。 對于此工具，以下表述均為真： 域為：-∞ < [in_value] < ∞ 范圍為：-1 < [out_value] < 1 請注意，-∞ 和 ∞ 分別表示受特定網格格式支持的最小負值和最大正值。
該工具中的輸入和輸出值被看作是無單位量。
無論輸入資料為何種類型，輸出值都始終為浮點型。
如果輸入是多波段網格，則輸出也將為多波段網格。 該工具將在輸入中的每個波段上執行操作。
如果輸入是多維網格資料，則將處理所有變量的所有剖切。 輸出將是 CRF 格式的多維網格。

屬性域管理包括以下步驟： 使用 創建屬性域 工具創建屬性域。 使用此工具或 設置范圍屬性域的值 工具添加屬性域的值或為其設置值范圍。 使用 指定欄位的屬性域 工具將屬性域與圖徵類相關聯。
編碼值屬性域既包括存儲在資料庫中的實際值（例如，1 代表硬路面），也包括對編碼值含義的描述（例如，硬路面）。
A coded value domain which specifies a valid set of values for an attribute can apply to any type of attribute—文本、數值、日期等。 例如，文本屬性的編碼值列表可能包括有效的管道材料值：CL - 鑄鐵管；DL - 球墨鑄鐵管；ACP - 石棉混凝土管；或者可能包括表示有效管徑的數值：75–3/4"；2–2"；24–24"；和 30–30"。

AddCodedValueToDomain 示例 2（獨立腳本）
此獨立腳本將 AddCodedValueToDomain 函數用作工作流的一部分，以創建屬性域并為其賦值。

topic: 向屬性域添加編碼值 (資料管理工具)
text:
# Name: MakeDomain.py
# Description: Create an attribute domain to constrain pipe material values

# Import system modules
import arcpy

# Set the workspace (to avoid having to type in the full path to the data every time)
arcpy.env.workspace = "C:/data"

# Set local parameters
domName = "Material4"
gdb = "montgomery.gdb"
inFeatures = "Montgomery.gdb/Water/Distribmains"
inField = "Material"

# Process: Create the coded value domain
arcpy.management.CreateDomain("montgomery.gdb", domName, "Valid pipe materials",
                              "TEXT", "CODED")

# Store all the domain values in a dictionary with the domain code as the "key"
# and the domain description as the "value" (domDict[code])
domDict = {"CI":"Cast iron", "DI": "Ductile iron", "PVC": "PVC", \
           "ACP": "Asbestos concrete", "COP": "Copper"}

# Process: Add valid material types to the domain
# use a for loop to cycle through all the domain codes in the dictionary
for code in domDict:
    arcpy.management.AddCodedValueToDomain(gdb, domName, code, domDict[code])

# Process: Constrain the material value of distribution mains
arcpy.management.AssignDomainToField(inFeatures, inField, domName)

text:
此消息指示使用當前參數運行工具后，輸出時空立方體的開始時間和結束時間。
對于大多數顯示此消息的工具，輸出時空立方體將具有與輸入時空立方體相同的時間跨度。 對于時間序列預測工具集中的工具，時間跨度將包括在立方體末尾附加的預測時間步長。
對于子集化時空立方體工具，輸出時空立方體的時間跨度基于時間子集方法參數值。
用戶定義 - 時間跨度基于子集時間跨度參數中提供的開始時間和結束時間。
時空立方體 - 時間跨度基于輸入時態子集立方體的開始時間和結束時間。
時間步長數 - 時間跨度基于從輸入時空立方體的開始或結束時間刪除的時間步長數。 例如，如果刪除前兩個條柱，消息將顯示第三個條柱的開始時間。 相似地，當從末尾刪除條柱時，將顯示剩余的最后一個條柱的結束時間。

topic: 230007：輸出立方體的時間跨度將為從 <value> 至 <value>。
english: 230007: The time span of the output cube will be from <value> to <value>.
text: 對于“用戶定義”和“時空立方體時態子集”方法，如果指定的開始時間和結束時間與輸入時空立方體條柱的開始和結束時間不一致，則輸出時空立方體的時間跨度可能不同。 例如，如果指定的開始時間和結束時間分別為 1/24/2019 和 12/24/2019，則消息將顯示包含指定開始時間的條柱的開始時間和包含指定結束時間的條柱的結束時間。 在本例中，如果每月聚合立方體，則 1/24/2019 和 12/24/2019 將分別與條柱 1/1/2019 到 1/31/2019 和條柱 12/1/2019 到 12/31/2019 相交，而輸出時空立方體的時間跨度將為 1/1/2019 到 12/31/2019。

text:
此工具接受 shapefile、地理資料庫圖徵類和屬性關系類作為輸入。
在已提供輸入表參數值的情況下，如果索引名稱參數為空，則資料集中不存在任何屬性索引。
添加索引后，可以在圖徵類或表的生命周期內隨時刪除并重新添加索引。
對于未注冊為版本的企業級地理資料庫，可以刪除 GlobalID 欄位上的唯一索引和非唯一索引。 但是，如果您移除 GlobalID 欄位上的索引，則建議您在 GlobalID 欄位上重新添加一個索引以提高圖徵類或表的屬性查詢性能。

text:
PCA 和 MNF 都廣泛用于減少高光譜影像中的波段數量，但兩者在優化目標、噪聲處理方式以及對高光譜資料的適用性上存在差異。
PCA 是一種統計變換方法，該變換將原始光譜波段重新投影到一組新的正交分量中，并按所解釋的總方差進行排序。 第一個分量解釋最大的方差（通常包含最多信息），第二個分量解釋次大的方差，依此類推。
MNF 是一種噪聲調整的 PCA 方法，專門為高光譜影像而設計。 該方法估計噪聲協方差矩陣，并轉換資料，使噪聲具有單位方差（噪聲經過歸一化，使得一個變化單位等于一個噪聲標準差）且不相關。 一旦噪聲方差 = 1 且噪聲相關性 = 0，那么光譜空間中任何方差大于 1 的方向必定包含信號。 然后，通過 PCA 對資料進行變換，各分量按信噪比 (SNR) 從高到低排序，從而將有意義的資料與噪聲分離以獲得更好的分析效果，這與優先考慮總方差的標準 PCA 不同。
該工具接收一個多波段或高光譜輸入影像，并輸出一個包含指定數量 MNF 和 PCA 分量（波段）的變換后網格。 將光譜波段變換并減少至包含最相關影像信息的波段，可提高處理效率與精度。

topic: 類別概率 (Spatial Analyst 工具)
text:
將多波段網格指定為輸入網格波段（Python 中的 in_raster_bands）之一時，將使用所有波段。 要處理一系列來自多波段網格的波段，可以首先用波段合成工具創建由這些特定波段組成的新網格資料集，并將該結果用于輸入網格波段列表（Python 中的 in_raster_bands）。
通過創建特征文件、編輯特征文件或 Iso 聚類工具創建的任何特征文件，對于輸入特征文件而言均為有效條目。 它們都具有 .gsg 擴展名。
此工具采用貝葉斯統計來評估類別概率。 貝葉斯統計包括以關于資料的先驗信息開始，然后在收集資料后更新該信息。 有關資料值的先驗信息將被先驗概率進行量化，然后先驗概率被通過似然函數加以調整以接收后驗概率（已更新的信息）。 似然函數由每個類/聚類的資料值定義。
輸入先驗概率文件必須是包含兩列的 ASCII 文件。 左列中的值表示類 ID。 右列中的值表示相應類的先驗概率。 類別先驗概率的有效值必須大于或等于零。 如果指定零作為概率，則不會為輸出多波段網格中的類創建任何關聯的概率波段。 指定先驗概率的總和必須小于或等于一。 顯示文件格式的示例如下： ``<!--nohighlight 1 .3 2 .1 4 .0 5 .15 7 .05 8 .2 --><!-- 文件中所忽略的類將接收值 1 其余部分的平均先驗概率。 在上面的示例中，所有從 1 到 8 的類都在特征文件中表示。 類 3 和類 6 的先驗概率在輸入先驗概率文件中缺失。 由于上述文件中所有指定概率的總和等于 0.8，概率的其余部分 (0.2) 將與未指定類的數量 (2) 相除。 因此，類 3 和類 6 將被分別指定概率 0.1。 輸入先驗概率文件的擴展名可以是 .txt 或 .asc。
用作最大輸出值的輸入值可用來設置輸出概率波段中值的范圍上限。 默認值 100 將為各波段創建整數值范圍為 0 到 100 的多波段網格。 任何大于零的整數值都可用作有效的最大輸出值。 僅最大輸出值參數的值 1 將導致波段具有浮點值。
有關適用于此工具的地理處理環境的詳細信息，請參閱分析環境和 Spatial Analyst。

依用法、環境與授權段落核對限制。確認輸出位置或就地修改範圍後執行 Run。
在 Geoprocessing History 檢查執行狀態與訊息，再核對結果是否符合使用者指定的範圍與條件。
provenance: 依官方參數表編排的操作清單

topic: 類別概率 (Spatial Analyst 工具)
section: 英文版工具簽章與參數順序

parameters.description_en: The input raster bands. They can be integer or floating point type.
Input signature file whose class signatures are used to generate the a priori probability bands. A .gsg extension is required.
Factor for scaling the range of values in the output probability bands. By default, the values range from 0 to 100.

Specifies how a priori probabilities will be determined. Equal—All classes will have the same a priori probability. This is the default. Sample—A priori probabilities will be proportional to the number of cells in each class relative to the total number of cells sampled in all classes in the signature file. File—The a priori probabilities will be assigned to each class from an input ASCII a priori probability file.

parameters.label_zh: 輸入先驗概率文件 （可選）
parameters.description_en: A text file containing a priori probabilities for the input signature classes. An input for the a priori probability file is only required when the File option is used. The extension for the a priori file can be .txt or .asc.

text: 依英文版參數表順序列出：in_raster_bands、in_signature_file、maximum_output_value、a_priori_probabilities、in_a_priori_file。選填標示、資料型別與英文原說明見 parameters。

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
text:
支持“Z 分辨率”環境的工具可將 z 分辨率應用到輸出地理資料集中。 z 分辨率（表示非常小的距離）是指用于存儲 z 座標值的有效數字的位數。
有關默認 z 分辨率的說明，請參閱以下主題：空間參考與地理處理。

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
text:
如果輸出位于地理資料庫圖徵資料集內，則將忽略此環境設置。
如果未設置“Z 分辨率”環境，工具（例如，創建圖徵類、創建圖徵資料集和創建網格目錄）會將默認 Z 分辨率設置為 0.0001 個單位。

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
text: Z 分辨率 - 為輸出地理資料集設置的 Z 分辨率。 如果默認 Z 分辨率不足，請設置此環境。

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
text: arcpy.env.ZResolution = linear_unit

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
values: 設置用于輸出地理資料集的 z 分辨率。 z 分辨率（表示非常小的距離）是指用于存儲 z 座標值的有效數字的位數。

topic: Z 分辨率 (環境設置)
text:
import arcpy

# Set the ZResolution environment to a linear unit
arcpy.env.ZResolution = "0.002 Meters"
